propositions.proposition: The billing record lists billed_name as Vellum Print Co Ltd.

propositions.proposition: SOW-VEL-2022 contains no change-of-control clause and assignment is unrestricted.
propositions.relevance: Describes contractual assignment terms for the contract referent; does not establish identity or distinctness between the billing and contract referents.
